detail.longDescription: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.
